analyst_view.overall: Monaco (7th, 16 points) have gone five league games without a win under Filipe Luís and have not kept a clean sheet in eight, while Auxerre (15th, 10 points) under Will Still have lost their last two, including 5-1 at Strasbourg, and have conceded a league-high 24 goals. Filipe Luís confirmed Golovin (calf), Idumbo and Ansu Fati are out, all counted by the numbers, with defender Mawissa a game-day decision on a groin problem; Coulibaly is available because his ban starts next round. Auxerre's striker Danny Namaso is ruled out with a swollen ankle (Camfoot, Eurofootnews), as the numbers already assumed, alongside Okoh, Dioussé, Fofana and Zaddy, with Oppegard doubtful and Dioubaté back from suspension. Filipe Luís expects a compact Auxerre that breaks fast through Archer and Faivre and says Monaco must take risks. Referee Jérémy Stinat (4.1 cards a game) is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals and already take almost a fifth off Auxerre's attack for Namaso, now confirmed out, and some off Monaco for Golovin and Idumbo. Monaco's leaky defence and Auxerre's poor one are already in the numbers too, so I stay at 2.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, with Monaco expected to have most of the ball against Auxerre's back three and wing-backs. Filipe Luís wants more risk going forward, but that is how Monaco usually play at home, so I stay at 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards and already add Stinat's slightly strict record and past meetings. Dioubaté returns for Auxerre and Coulibaly is available for Monaco, but nothing points to a heated game, so I stay at 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.9 shots. Filipe Luís admits his attack has struggled without Golovin, which is already counted, and Auxerre will sit compact and counter; nothing new points either way, so I stay at 23.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. With Namaso out as the numbers assumed, Archer is Auxerre's main threat, and Monaco's finishing problems are already in their recent record, so I stay at 9.3.
